parameters.query:
SELECT pm.nombre, tr.porcentaje_congestion, tr.estado, tr.captured_at
FROM puntos_monitoreo pm
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM traffic_readings t
  WHERE t.punto_nombre = pm.nombre
  ORDER BY captured_at DESC LIMIT 1
) tr ON true
WHERE $1::double precision IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (pm.latitude - $1)^2 + (pm.longitude - $2)^2 ASC
LIMIT 1;
